summary: Iteration 8 — Central Profissional de Transmissão ao Vivo (LiveKit WebRTC, propositalmente NÃO configurado nesta fase). Added 14 new backend tests across 6 classes (TestLiveKitStatusAndPermissions, TestBroadcastCRUDAndAccess, TestBroadcastLifecycleAndNotify, TestBroadcastChatAndModeration, TestBroadcastAnalytics, TestBroadcastStageInvariant) — 14/14 pass. Full suite: 87 passed / 1 skipped by design / 2 pre-existing flakes (already documented in iteration 7 report — GET /api/notifications 50-cap and TestExternalMediaCRUDAndAccess race, NOT caused by broadcast feature). Playwright (mobile 390x844) validated: (a) FORMADOR /app/transmissoes shows broadcast-new-btn; can fill broadcast-title + broadcast-stage-3 + broadcast-create-submit and lands on /app/estudio/{id}; Studio renders studio-page with lk-not-configured banner, request-devices-btn, checklist listing 'Servidor de transmissão' and go-live-btn disabled (as expected without device permissions/LiveKit); mode-toggle switches without crash; (b) MEMBRO (etapa 3) at /app/transmissoes does NOT see broadcast-new-btn, sees the LIVE broadcast card, opens /app/ao-vivo/{id} → viewer-page + viewer-no-server visible (LiveKit not configured), chat-panel + chat-input + chat-send work (message posted via real MongoDB polling — appears in-list); (c) PREVOC (etapa 1) opening the stage-3 broadcast gets viewer-error (403 by stage); (d) profile-transmissoes link visible for formador. Backend: /api/livekit/status → {configured:false}; POST /api/broadcasts/{id}/token → 503 with no secret leakage; auto-notify to stage-scoped members works ('🔴 Estamos ao vivo!'); moderation (mute/block/toggle_chat/delete msg) requires MODERATE_LIVE and blocked user gets 403 on POST /chat; takeover requires TAKE_OVER_LIVE (only mestre); report requires VIEW_LIVE_ANALYTICS; heartbeat updates viewers/viewers_peak; STAGE INVARIANT verified: none of start/end/heartbeat/chat/takeover mutate user.current_stage_order. All 7 new perms present in /permissions/catalog (MANAGE_LIVE, MANAGE_CAMERA, MANAGE_MICROPHONE, MANAGE_SCENES, MANAGE_SOURCES, VIEW_LIVE_ANALYTICS, TAKE_OVER_LIVE). Test data cleanup verified — no residual TEST_BC/TEST_UI_BC broadcasts, no accounts left blocked/muted.

minor.issue: Still capped at .to_list(50) without pagination/since filter — carried over from iteration 6/7. Not a broadcast regression but affects any test/UI that needs to detect recent notifications when total > 50.

Dead code + subtle bug: at server.py:1425-1426 the favorite branch inserts the fav then falls through into the LiveKit section comment; the `return {"ok": True, "favorited": True}` (line 1760) is UNREACHABLE — placed inside a function that no longer exists. In practice the function ends implicitly (Python returns None → FastAPI 200 with 'null'). Behavior still 'works' but return contract broken and orphaned return statement should be removed / properly nested.

action_items: (Optional) Fix orphaned favorite return at server.py:1760 — should be inside toggle_media_favorite before the CENTRAL DE TRANSMISSÃO section; currently returns null instead of {ok:true,favorited:true}.
(Nice-to-have) Paginate /api/notifications so downstream tests/UI can reliably detect newly-created broadcast notifications (still the same recommendation from iteration 7).
(Refactor) server.py is now ~2040 lines; broadcast (~330 lines) and media (~300 lines) are strong candidates to split into backend/routers/.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1425-1426: `await db.media_favorites.insert_one(...)` is immediately followed by a top-level comment/block `# ============= CENTRAL DE TRANSMISSÃO ...` — the favorite function body ends abruptly; the return {ok:true,favorited:true} at line 1760 is dead code sitting outside any function. Bug in code layout even though runtime happens to still return 200 (null).

start_broadcast iterates `async for m in db.users.find(q)` and awaits notify() per member — same anti-pattern flagged in iterations 6/7 for lives/media go-live. Consider bulk insert_many for notifications when going live to avoid N round-trips.

broadcast_accessible() gives full access to admins & formadores regardless of `stages` — consistent with media_accessible but again the invariant is 'apenas Mestre altera etapas', not 'apenas Mestre vê tudo'. Confirm intended behaviour with product owner.
POST /api/broadcasts/{id}/token generates JWT with 15-minute TTL and role derived server-side (good), but the endpoint does not rate-limit token issuance. Consider a short cooldown to avoid abuse.

moderate_broadcast trusts arbitrary `body: dict` — no Pydantic schema. Introduce a ModeratePayload model with Literal['mute','unmute','block','unblock','toggle_chat'] to reject invalid payloads before touching the DB.
GET /api/broadcasts/{id}/chat uses `.to_list(200)` with no since filter enforcement (since is honored but unbounded messages ≥200 will silently truncate). Add pagination or a hard cap warning.

rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no functional broadcast bug found. Minor issue: orphaned `return {ok:true,favorited:true}` at server.py:1760 outside any function is a code-layout bug (dead code, function returns null instead of the intended body). Runtime doesn't error but the contract is inconsistent.
